## Sarvam-30B appendix CI (Ancoda-250k − Sarvam-30B, Devanagari mean)

- FLORES+ per-sentence Deva mean: Ancoda-250k=1.376533, Sarvam-30B=1.866931, diff=−0.490398.
- FLORES+ 95% CI: **WIN -0.490398 [-0.496674, -0.484216]** (per-sentence, n=10000, seed=20261104).
- Sealed no-joiners Dev11 mean CI (`sealed_nojjoiners_remeasure.json`): **WIN −0.5548 [−0.5942, −0.5285]** (n=10000, seed 20261104).
